verdict.rationale: Spot or interruptible GPU capacity is a fair question for a GPU cloud, so the axis applies, but the pack never mentions spot, preemptible, or interruptible instances, or any preemption semantics. The 'save up to 70%' claim compares general pricing against major public clouds and is not a discounted interruptible tier. Auto-shutdown on inactivity is an adjacent control, not preemption.
